To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the QoS parameters are not well defined and the QoS is not well understood by the customers and the operators.

the quality of service parameters in the cellular mobile communication industry is a function of the following dimensions: (i) service availability; (ii) service accessibility; (iii) service quality and (iv) service cost.
The quality of service parameters are not only the responsibility of the network operators.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification, measurement and evaluation of the service quality parameters for mobile communication services.
the identification of the QoS parameters in cellular mobile communications, and the evaluation of these parameters.
the development of QoS parameters and their application in cellular mobile communication.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there is a need to develop and implement an integrated QoS model that would provide the service provider with a tool to monitor, measure and control QoS.
the QoS parameters for cellular mobile telecommunication should be based on customer satisfaction and service quality.
QoS parameters for cellular mobile services should be defined in terms of a set of service quality dimensions.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a number of QoS parameters are identified, which are important for cellular mobile communication services.
QoS parameters in cellular mobile communications should be defined in terms of the service provider, service user and service environment.

there is no universal set of QoS parameters for cellular mobile service, and that the QoS parameters should be selected based on the service provider’s objectives, customer needs, and the technology used.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the service quality of cellular mobile communication should be viewed as a multidimensional phenomenon.
the service quality in mobile telecommunication can be evaluated by a set of parameters that are derived from the technical and managerial dimensions.
there is a need to develop a model to measure the service quality parameters in the context of cellular mobile communication, and that this model should be based on the dimensions of service quality.
